**How to submit:** Write on paper and show your steps. Upload a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 5**.
No task needs AI.

Use these values: cos 60° = 0.5, sin 60° = 0.87, sin 90° = 1, sin 180° = 0,
sin 270° = −1.

## Task 1 · The cannon (2 marks)

A cannon in a pirate game fires a ball at the angle 60° with the speed 20.

a) Find the velocity of the ball: 20 × (cos 60°, sin 60°). (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The cannon turns to 120°. The point at 120° on the unit circle is
(−0.5, 0.87). Does the ball now fly to the left or to the right? Give the
reason. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · The coin (3 marks)

A coin floats in the air and bobs: y = 4 + 0.5 × sin(360° × t ÷ 2).

a) Write the middle, the amplitude and the period of the coin. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Find the height of the coin at t = 0.5 s and at t = 1.5 s. Show the
angle each time. (2 marks)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}
